cars.name: Small Hatchback
cars.notes: Nimble starter. Single hit totals it, barely survives a scrape.

cars.name: Midsize Crossover
cars.notes: Boring baseline. Absorbs a few scrapes.

cars.name: JDM Tuner
cars.notes: Best agility. Fragile like the hatchback. Wide body kit makes it slightly wider than the hatchback.

cars.name: Escalade-Type Truck
cars.notes: Tank. Survives a full rear-end hit, widest hitbox, slowest lane changes.

cars.name: 80s Supercar
cars.notes: Countach-inspired wedge with DeLorean-style influences. Marginally lighter than the crossover. Lowest durability.

size_note: size is mainly width and drives hitbox width
unlock_note: all thresholds are placeholders to tune
